question: Can an explicit, evidence-bounded runtime contract distinguish first-pass execution incompatibility from B-Rep-to-CAD modeling failure?
model_class: low-complexity external first-pass B-Rep-to-script reconstruction under an unchanged sandbox and geometry-gate policy

required_facts: selected input is readable through the bounded probe
existing bbox, volume, and topology gates
ambiguity_or_fail_closed_conditions: provider timeout without a generated artifact
changed model, provider, executor, gates, or split after development review

constrained_hypothesis: A concise contract limited to the sandbox input path, output location, installed OCP import compatibility, and execution expectations may reduce execution-readiness failures; it does not infer feature semantics or establish modeling improvement. M43/M44 further show that geometry gates alone accept direct input STEP re-export, so they cannot establish reconstruction provenance.

gate_or_diagnostic: existing input/output readability and geometry gates
stopping_rule: no hosted request under this design workpack
if development evidence lacks attributable gate-level improvement, do not widen context or sample scope
held-out follows only a frozen development review and separate explicit authorization
do not promote a contract to a helper, experience card, or runtime policy from this evidence alone

existing: M10-012 directly reproduced two sandbox host-path failures and showed that /input/model.step restored fixed-script execution; an unavailable OCP import remained a non-match.
Completed hosted reports show that many first-pass results fail before readable output, so geometry outcomes are often unavailable.
missing_counterexample: a frozen hosted development comparison showing that the same policy with the bounded contract does not simply shift failures to an unrelated stage
a separately authorized held-out result under an unchanged selected policy
evidence.next_minimal_experiment: M43/M44 completed the separately authorized development and held-out comparison. The held-out all-gate pass was a direct input STEP re-export, so the next eligible work is a separately selected Q03 reconstruction-provenance gate design, not another hosted rerun.
